profileLabel: Institution-supporting; mildly protective civil liberties (low-medium confidence)
summary: Cebu City 1st District representative with 158 principal-authored bills. Authored a stronger right to information, anti-dynasty ban, a libel venue rule protecting local media, juvenile justice strengthening, life imprisonment without parole for child rape, estate tax abolition and a constitutional convention bill.
caveat: Civil-liberties score nets a protective press bill and juvenile justice against a harsh sentencing bill. Estate tax abolition alone does not support an economic score.

economic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
